 Blog By - Team MyGov, 
 Ministry of Labour & Employment 
 October 26, 2026 
 To commemorate the 74th Foundation Day of the Employees’ Provident Fund Organisation (EPFO), the Ministry of Labour & Employment, in collaboration with MyGov, organised the “ EPFO Foundation Day Quiz 2026 ”. The quiz aimed to create awareness about EPFO’s schemes and services, including the Employees’ Provident Fund Scheme, 2026, the Employees’ Pension Scheme, 2026, PMVBRY and Vishwas 2026.
 The quiz was conducted from 13 October 2026 to 23 October 2026 and received an enthusiastic response, with 8,584 participants from across the country.
 We are pleased to announce the winners of the quiz:

 The winners will be felicitated at the Foundation Day function scheduled for 1 November 2026 in New Delhi .
 All participants will receive e-certificates.
 EPFO and MyGov extend their appreciation to all participants for their enthusiastic participation and look forward to their continued engagement in future MyGov activities.
 Congratulations to all the winners!
